## Teaching points

1. Firm sustained compression of the lower nose is first-line for active anterior bleeding.
2. Confirm that bleeding is controlled and assess its severity before discharge.
3. Pinching the bony bridge and repeatedly releasing pressure are ineffective techniques.
4. Recurrent unilateral or difficult-to-control bleeding needs further assessment; treatment options depend on the identified source.
